text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that overnight on-street permit parking hours be extended on the east leg of Sumach Street, between Eastern Avenue and a point 54 metres north, from 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., 7 days a week to the new hours of 12:01 a.m. of one day to 12:01 a.m., the following day, 7 days a week. Residents requested the extension of the overnight on-street permit parking hours on the east leg Sumach Street, to improve parking flexibility and to allow the Parking Enforcement Unit, Toronto Police Service, to effectively control long term parking by non-residents through tagging and towing operations.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the extension of the overnight on-street permit parking hours on the east leg of Sumach Street, between Eastern Avenue and a point 54 metres north from 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., 7 days a week to the new hours of 12:01 a.m. of one day to 12:01 a.m., of the following day, 7 days a week. 2.
